The invocation exactly as the issue cites it -- the RUN: line of
tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/dxil/debug/misc/share_mem_dbg.hlsl:

%dxc -E main -T cs_6_0 -Zi -Od -DDefineA -DDefineB=0 %s -Qstrip_reflect | FileCheck %s

cmd.txt expands the two lit substitutions and drops the FileCheck pipe; nothing
else differs. See cmd.txt for the reasoning.

Note on the configuration dependence the issue asserts: in 2020 the
HLSLFileCheck suite was driven through the compiler API by a C++ harness, which
is the "test infrastructure ... skips the initial compile operations found in
dxc.cpp" the reporter contrasts with. Today lit runs the same file through the
real dxc.exe (%dxc == the binary, tools/clang/test/lit.cfg:294). This triage
measures the command-line path -- dxc.exe with an argv -- which is the path the
issue says is affected.
